## Feedback file

If you pressed F9 (or Feedback) and wrote a note, attach the
`feedback-*.json`. If the page offered a crash report, attach that too.
The stamp inside the file should match the badge.

Leave out anything that is not about this bug. Do not put passwords or
tokens in the file or in this issue.
